name: Acne-Prone Skin
description: Acne-prone skin is characterized by frequent breakouts, blackheads, whiteheads, and possible inflammation. This type of skin often requires a more targeted skincare regimen to manage oil production and prevent bacteria from causing further irritation.

morning_routine.purpose: Prevent irritation from excessive water exposure

night_routine.action: Gently exfoliate once or twice weekly (using a mild exfoliant)
night_routine.purpose: Remove dead skin cells without causing irritation
Promote cell turnover and reduce breakouts
Hydrate skin without causing additional oiliness

weekly_care: Deep clean with a clay mask
dont: Assume all acne is due to dirt or poor hygiene

seasonal_care.summer: Use lighter, oil-free formulas and increase product frequency
seasonal_care.winter: Increase hydration by using more moisturizing products
seasonal_care.monsoon: Adjust product consistency based on skin's reaction; consider heavier formulations

expert_tips: Consult a dermatologist for personalized advice and treatment plans
